title: QR Code Generator
description: A complete QR Code generator implementing the full ISO/IEC 18004 standard for Version 1 codes. Features Reed-Solomon error correction with Galois field arithmetic for up to 38% damage recovery, automatic best-mask selection using penalty scoring rules, and three encoding modes (Numeric, Alphanumeric, Byte). Outputs ASCII art, Unicode block graphics, and scalable SVG. Pure Python with no external dependencies.
